getPayment_id() returns the default field value 0 when setPayment_id(int) has not been called.
When payment_id is set via setPayment_id, getPayment_id returns the same value.
When payment_id is not set, getPayment_id returns the default value (0).
When payment_id is set multiple times, getPayment_id returns the most recently set value.
getPayment_id() returns the value that was set by setPayment_id(int).
getAmount() returns the value that was set by setAmount(double).
getPayment_id() returns 0 when setPayment_id(int) has not been called.
getPayment_id() returns the value passed to setPayment_id(int) after it is set.
getPayment_id() returns the most recently set value when setPayment_id(int) is called multiple times with different values.
getAccount_id() returns the value that was set by setAccount_id(int).
